name: final-copied-artifact-and-process-readback
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$fixtureRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath 'C:\taki-c1a-fixture-86700c396b3348a7addf83ffc8273674').Path
if ([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $fixtureRoot '.c1a-owned-fixture')) -ne 'C1A_FAKE_ONLY') { throw 'not owned' }
$registrationPath = Join-Path $fixtureRoot 'registration.json'
$registration = Get-Content -LiteralPath $registrationPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$invocation = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fixtureRoot 'invocation.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$payloadRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $registration.installationRoot).Path
if (-not $payloadRoot.StartsWith($fixtureRoot + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'payload outside owned root' }
$manifestPath = Join-Path $payloadRoot 'manifest.json'
$manifest = Get-Content -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
$mismatches = @(foreach ($entry in $manifest.files) {
    $artifactPath = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $payloadRoot $entry.path))
    if (-not $artifactPath.StartsWith($payloadRoot + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'manifest entry outside payload' }
    if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $artifactPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $entry.sha256) { $entry.path }
})
$versions = [ordered]@{}
foreach ($package in @('libsodium', 'libsodium-wrappers', 'json-rpc-2.0', 'ws', 'zod')) {
    $metadata = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $payloadRoot ('node_modules/' + $package + '/package.json')) -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    $versions[$package] = $metadata.version
}
$manifestHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$runtimeHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $registration.runtime.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$adapterHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $registration.custody.adapter.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$catalogHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $registration.coreDataDirectory 'secret-catalog.bin') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$fixtureProcesses = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($fixtureRoot + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, ExecutablePath)
$reparsePoints = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $fixtureRoot -Recurse -Force -Attributes ReparsePoint | Select-Object FullName, LinkType, Target)
$evidence = [PSCustomObject]@{
    fixtureRoot = $fixtureRoot
    checkedAt = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
    build = $manifest.build
    platform = $manifest.platform
    architecture = $manifest.architecture
    manifestFileCount = $manifest.files.Count
    actualPayloadFileCount = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $payloadRoot -Recurse -File -Force).Count
    manifestSha256 = $manifestHash
    manifestMatchesRegistration = ($manifestHash -eq $registration.manifestSha256)
    manifestEntryHashMismatches = $mismatches
    registrationSha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $registrationPath -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    runtime = @{ path = $registration.runtime.path; sha256 = $runtimeHash; version = $registration.runtime.version; matchesRegistration = ($runtimeHash -eq $registration.runtime.sha256) }
    fakeAdapter = @{ path = $registration.custody.adapter.path; sha256 = $adapterHash; matchesRegistration = ($adapterHash -eq $registration.custody.adapter.sha256) }
    dependencyVersions = $versions
    catalogSha256 = $catalogHash
    catalogUnchanged = ($catalogHash -eq $invocation.input.sealedEnvelopeSha256)
    preloadFileAbsent = (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fixtureRoot 'preload-ran')))
    fixtureProcesses = $fixtureProcesses
    reparsePoints = $reparsePoints
    originalPermissionsChanged = $false
    originalDataTouched = $false
}
$evidence | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
if ($mismatches.Count -ne 0 -or -not $evidence.manifestMatchesRegistration -or -not $evidence.runtime.matchesRegistration -or -not $evidence.fakeAdapter.matchesRegistration -or -not $evidence.catalogUnchanged -or -not $evidence.preloadFileAbsent -or $fixtureProcesses.Count -ne 0) { exit 1 }

name: owned-fixture-cleanup-and-readback
command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$expectedRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath('C:\taki-c1a-fixture-86700c396b3348a7addf83ffc8273674')
$fixtureRoot = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $expectedRoot).Path
if (-not $fixtureRoot.Equals($expectedRoot, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'unexpected resolved root' }
$rootItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $fixtureRoot -Force
if (($rootItem.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint) -ne 0) { throw 'root cannot be a link' }
if ([IO.File]::ReadAllText((Join-Path $fixtureRoot '.c1a-owned-fixture')) -ne 'C1A_FAKE_ONLY') { throw 'not an owned fake fixture' }
$before = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($fixtureRoot + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, ExecutablePath)
if ($before.Count -ne 0) { $before | ConvertTo-Json; throw 'fixture processes remain' }
$expectedJunction = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $fixtureRoot 'catalog-junction'))
$expectedTarget = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $fixtureRoot 'fake-core-data'))
$links = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $fixtureRoot -Recurse -Force -Attributes ReparsePoint)
if ($links.Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected reparse inventory' }
$link = $links[0]
$targets = @($link.Target)
if (-not $link.FullName.Equals($expectedJunction, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or $link.LinkType -ne 'Junction' -or $targets.Count -ne 1) { throw 'unexpected junction' }
$resolvedTarget = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $targets[0]).Path
if (-not $resolvedTarget.Equals($expectedTarget, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or -not $resolvedTarget.StartsWith($fixtureRoot + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { throw 'junction target outside fixture' }
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $expectedJunction -Force
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $expectedJunction) { throw 'junction unlink failed' }
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $fixtureRoot -Recurse -Force
$after = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ExecutablePath -and $_.ExecutablePath.StartsWith($fixtureRoot + '\', [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, ExecutablePath)
$remaining = @(if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $fixtureRoot) { $fixtureRoot })
$evidence = [PSCustomObject]@{
    removedPaths = @($fixtureRoot)
    detachedJunction = $expectedJunction
    verifiedJunctionTarget = $resolvedTarget
    remainingPaths = $remaining
    fixtureProcessesBeforeCleanup = $before
    fixtureProcessesAfterCleanup = $after
    cargoTargetRetained = (Test-Path -LiteralPath 'apps/desktop/src-tauri/target' -PathType Container)
    originalPermissionsChanged = $false
    originalDataTouched = $false
    hFreeBytes = (Get-PSDrive -Name H).Free
    checkedAt = [DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
}
$evidence | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
if ($remaining.Count -ne 0 -or $after.Count -ne 0 -or -not $evidence.cargoTargetRetained) { exit 1 }
